description:
Activate Cradle Clearcutter by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Cradle Clearcutter.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Cradle Clearcutter.
Repeat.

uses.name: Cradle Clearcutter
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and with power 2 or greater
